problem_type: Interactive canvas import outlives its originating project
symptom: Capacity/dimensions/upload completion or retry writes after project replacement
direct_cause: Async preparation captures global project too late and retry stores files without originating lifetime
class_root: Project IO authority for an action was self-captured wherever each helper remembered to (or defaulted late after awaits) instead of being issued once at the action entry by the owner of window + project identity
affected_population: Node and reference slot file uploads
Global screenshot hotkey capture and crop panel
Video frame and shot-cut extraction to canvas

Interactive actions that used to re-read the open project after an await (director outputs, decompose layers, clip export, timeline adds, result deletion, workflow copy, spend confirm refresh, shot verify fix, prompt optimizer, journey tour, memory edits, frame/group menu feedback)
Browser asset overlay and dialog (child window) imports, prompt captures, prompt template settings and file deletion
Display surfaces labelled with the open project (asset pickers, filmstrip, production run panel, verify card, memory list)
internal_only_reason: Nomi coordinator hydration ownership, main session binding and global canvas store boundaries define the invariant; no new third-party API.
invariants: Capture full project binding before asynchronous preparation
Replacement permanently revokes old interactive actions, including A to B to A
Same-project page navigation preserves action identity
Cancelled operations cannot recover or persist data URLs

Renderer project IO authority is issued only by projectCanvasReadSurface (withProjectAction / withMainProjectAction); the capture is module-private and every downstream helper requires the issued context

Main-started actions (global screenshot hotkey) fix the committed surface binding and asset write context before their first await; the renderer adopts the action only while that exact binding is current
Interactive main IO requests carry the issued binding and join the trusted session before any await; explicit background IO still fixes disk identity before its long step

No business module reads 'the project that is open now': the renderer readers (desktop/activeProject, getActiveWorkbenchProjectId, getCanvasEventsProjectId) are deleted; display-only reads go through useOpenProjectId and every remaining read is pinned with a reason in projectActionIssuance.contract.test.ts

A child window has no project session of its own: its authority is derived by main from the parent window's committed project (windowProjectCapture), revoked together with it and refused when the parent has none; renderer-reported projectIds in child/browser IPC are not authority

door_reduction.why_not: The authority doors were merged: self-capture went from 20 committed call sites (31 with the in-flight branch work) to 0 outside projectCanvasReadSurface, and every remaining withProjectAction/withMainProjectAction row is a distinct user or main-started action entry that only receives the issued context. The other rows are consumers that must exist separately (typed ProjectExecutionContext parameters, lifetime checks, shared importers and the main-side session join) and cannot self-issue. 1b: the 99 renderer current-project reads (getActiveWorkbenchProjectId 31 + getDesktopActiveProjectId 66 + getCanvasEventsProjectId 4 minus definitions) went to 0 with the readers deleted; 14 display/transport reads remain through useOpenProjectId and captureCurrentProjectCanvasReadSurfaceBinding, each pinned with its reason. The added rows are the per-action issuance calls that replaced those reads, the display hook consumers and the main-side window issuance (screenshot hotkey, browser handlers, child-window asset import and deletion).

generality_proof: There is no longer a way to obtain project IO authority except at an issuance point: the renderer capture is module-private (compile error on import), shared helpers take a required context (compile error when forgotten, pinned by @ts-expect-error in projectActionIssuance.contract.test.ts under check:test-types), and the AST scan in the same test rejects issuance after an await, optional or nullable context parameters/properties and any private issuer reference anywhere in src. Main-started actions reuse the canvas read surface registry epoch capture plus captureAssetWriteContext instead of a renderer-reported id. Explicit background asset IO remains bound to its original project through its separately owned storage identity. The 'current project' readers themselves are deleted, and the reader ratchet in projectActionIssuance.contract.test.ts fails on any reference to them in src/ or electron/ and on any unpinned display/transport read. Child windows reuse the same main owner as the screenshot hotkey (issueWindowProject over the committed surface registry epoch) instead of a second session owner.

prevention.invariant: Only the originating project lifetime may publish an interactive import to the canvas
prevention.failure_mode: Project replacement or cancellation terminates without further IO, canvas mutation, retry, fallback or rejected UI promise
prevention.strategy: Single issuance point (module-private capture, required context parameters, AST and @ts-expect-error class tests) propagated to main session IO; main-started actions bind the registry epoch before awaits; deleted current-project readers with an AST reader ratchet; child windows issued by main from the parent window session

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unbound upload metadata and retry state; delete the exported self-capture and coordinator capture method, persistNodeImage default contexts, clip/image-upload/import/clipboard optional-context late fallbacks, importClipNodeAsset duplicate projectId parameter, and the nomi:screenshot:set-project renderer-reported project id channel (setScreenshotProjectId/currentProjectIdForCapture, preload/bridge setProjectId); 1b deletes the renderer current-project readers (getActiveWorkbenchProjectId, getCanvasEventsProjectId; src/desktop/activeProject.ts is declared removed in 2026-09-17-background-run-project-identity) and the payload projectId fields of the browser import/prompt capture/settings IPC

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing coordinator, store and importer

migration: No persisted schema changes; in-memory retries die with their project lifetime.
residual_risks: Real Electron drag/paste/screenshot/overlay project-switch journeys are not run in this code-convergence step (second step).

Child-window asset listing (nomi:assets:list) and the generic explicit-project IO channels still accept a projectId for reads and background IO from the main window; only child-window writes are bound to the parent session.
useOpenProjectId and captureCurrentProjectCanvasReadSurfaceBinding remain as 14 pinned display/transport reads; adding one requires arguing it into the ratchet.

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: Structure converged: projectCanvasReadSurface is the only renderer issuer of project IO authority (window + project key); helpers cannot self-capture (module visibility) or forget the context (required types); the class test pins issuance timing. Main-started and main IO paths bind the registry epoch / session before awaits. 1b: the readers are deleted and ratcheted; main owns child-window issuance through windowProjectCapture, shared with the screenshot hotkey.
